title: Yellow Fluffy Uruguayan Gelatin Pudding
description: A sweet and fluffy Uruguayan dessert featuring unflavored gelatin, perfect for brunch, and flexitarian friendly. It has a delicious glaze to top it off.
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over 1/4 cup of cold water and let it sit for 5 minutes to soften.
In a medium saucepan, combine the milk, sugar, and vanilla extract, and heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is hot but not boiling.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and cornstarch, then gradually add the lemon juice, whisking until smooth.
Gradually add the hot milk mixture to the egg yolk mixture, whisking constantly to prevent the eggs from scrambling.
Return the mixture to the saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and add the softened gelatin, stirring until it is fully dissolved.
Strain the mixture into a clean bowl and let it cool to room temperature.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate until the pudding is set, at least 3 hours.
Just before serving, melt the butter and mix with the confectioners sugar to make a glaze.
Serve the pudding chilled, topped with the glaze.
